name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted Crawl4AI server: a token-protected REST and MCP API that crawls websites with headless Chromium and returns LLM-ready markdown or structured data, plus a web playground.

alerts.message: Every API call needs the header Authorization: Bearer <token>, where the token is the generated CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN value in the environment. Paste the same token into the token bar of the playground at /playground.
